implemented: Added provider-neutral WebDiscoveryProvider protocol, opt-in injected provider support, bounded URL candidate validation, and a disabled default that preserves supplied-site discovery.
Search results remain untrusted; candidate fetches pass through the bounded company discovery transport, and the workflow requires matching employer text plus career or ATS evidence.

Added deterministic ATS detection across all 22 named hostname families plus redirects, vendor URL patterns, script/public API URLs, form actions, explicit embedded configuration, and JSON-LD metadata.

Detection records the visible careers URL, provider, confidence, evidence, competing candidates and application_supported=false; unknown, ambiguous and recognized-but-not-enumerable providers remain review/block states.
Custom-domain Greenhouse script evidence is retained separately from the visible careers URL and audited without claiming application support.

Generic recruiting/career URL paths and vendor words in visible prose, class names and generic data attributes do not independently identify an ATS; generic form routes remain below the confidence threshold.
limitations: REQ-062 PASS is limited to the explicitly optional provider abstraction: no external search provider or custom search endpoint is configured in production.
REQ-064 PARTIAL: HTML-signature detection and network-observed public endpoint detection are not implemented; public endpoint/script and form-action URL patterns are static page evidence only.
ATS detection is not application support. Non-mock ATS enumeration is intentionally blocked pending provider-specific validated collectors and explicit source policy.
Synthetic fixture HTML and hostname examples were used; production career sites were not fetched.
No database schema migration was added. No UI/browser UI acceptance was run because this change adds no UI code.
